info.description: Raw first-party event log (page views, product/category views, search, cart, wishlist, checkout, purchase). Written only through POST /api/analytics/track — do not create/edit records by hand.

eventName.description: Validated against the event allowlist in src/utils/analytics-events.js, not a DB enum, so new events don't need a migration.

customerId.description: documentId of api::customer.customer, denormalized (no formal relation) to keep event writes cheap and to avoid touching the Customer schema. Nullable for anonymous events.

occurredAt.description: Client-reported event time. Defaults to server receipt time if omitted.

properties.description: Event-specific extensible payload, e.g. { productId }, { searchQuery, resultCount }. Capped at 20 top-level keys server-side.
